press_references.value: The world’s HEAVIEST billboard has been unveiled in the UAE

overview_description.description:
GymNation is the Middle East’s largest low-cost gym operator, with close to 50 locations and over 200,000 members across the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and Bahrain. Founded in Dubai in 2018, GymNation was built on a simple mission: to make world-class fitness affordable and accessible to everyone.

GymNation’s vision is to be The Region’s Movement Partner, championing active, healthy lifestyles and the connection between physical activity and mental wellbeing across the communities it serves.

product.name: GymNation Gym Memberships
product.description: Monthly gym memberships providing 24/7 access to GymNation facilities, cardio and strength equipment, free weights, functional training areas, and member services across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Bahrain.

product.name: Group Exercise Classes
product.description: Instructor-led and virtual group fitness classes covering strength, cardio, conditioning, mobility, and mind-body training, including Les Mills, yoga, Zumba, boxing, Pilates, and HIIT formats.

product.name: Personal Training
product.description: One-to-one fitness coaching with customized workout plans, exercise-form guidance, motivation, and progress support tailored to a member’s goals, experience, body type, and lifestyle.

product.name: Ladies-Only Gyms
product.description: Separate women-only fitness facilities with dedicated entrances, training areas, female trainers, and women-focused group classes within selected GymNation locations.

product.name: Recovery Facilities
product.description: Gym-based recovery amenities including ice baths, saunas, steam rooms, and relaxation areas intended to support post-workout recovery and physical preparation.

product.name: HYROX Performance and Training Centres
product.description: Specialized training facilities and programming for members preparing for HYROX-style fitness competitions, combining endurance and functional strength training.
